Overlap with LieHighestWeightPartII, LieHighestWeight, ReflectionInvariantTheory, AdoIwasawa, RealSemisimpleLieGroups, ReductiveGroups, McKaySkewGroup, K3SurfacesAndSymplecticBoundedness and SpringerResolutionAndCharacteristicCycles: nothing doubly owned.
